Etcura v0.0.1 — first public release 🎉

A lightweight, cross-platform etcd desktop client: connection profiles, lazy key tree
browsing, CAS-protected value editing and automatic Protobuf decoding. Built with
Go + Wails v2 + Svelte 5.

## Highlights

- Connection profiles with multiple endpoints, TLS and real `Status` health checks;
  secrets stay in the OS keyring (macOS Keychain / Windows Credential Manager / Linux
  Secret Service)
- Lazy key tree with server-side cursor pagination — smooth on clusters with up to
  millions of keys, memory footprint independent of key count
- Value editor with CAS protection (compares on ModRevision — never silently
  overwritten), hex / Base64 views, JSON detection and formatting
- Protobuf decoding from imported `.proto` files — no protoc needed, cross-file
  imports supported
- English / 简体中文 UI, dark mode, `⌘R ⌘N ⌘S ⌘F` shortcuts

## Downloads

| Platform | Archive |
|---|---|
| macOS Apple Silicon | `etcura-darwin-arm64.zip` |
| macOS Intel | `etcura-darwin-amd64.zip` |
| macOS Universal | `etcura-darwin-universal.zip` |
| Windows x64 | `etcura-windows-amd64.zip` |
| Windows ARM64 | `etcura-windows-arm64.zip` |
| Linux x64 | `etcura-linux-amd64.zip` |
| Linux ARM64 | `etcura-linux-arm64.zip` |

SHA-256 checksums are attached alongside each archive (`*.sha256`).

## Install

- **macOS** — unzip and drag `etcura.app` into /Applications. Builds are ad-hoc signed
  (not notarized): right-click → Open on first launch, or run
  `xattr -cr /Applications/etcura.app`.
- **Windows** — unzip and run `etcura.exe`. Requires the WebView2 Runtime
  (preinstalled on Windows 11).
- **Linux** — unzip and run `./etcura`. Requires GTK3 and WebKitGTK 4.1, e.g.
  `sudo apt install libgtk-3-0t64 libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0`.

## Notes

- macOS is the most tested platform; the Windows and Linux builds are new in CI —
  issue reports are welcome.
- Roadmap: Watch live refresh, lease management, key history & diff, tabs,
  import/export, signed & notarized builds.
